# Mnemo Cortex

> Cognitive coprocessor with active memory for AI agents. A local server (default port 50001, REST plus a Streamable-HTTP MCP facade, and a Node MCP bridge for stdio hosts) that gives agents persistent recall across sessions: SQLite + sqlite-vec semantic recall with a keyword lane beside it, a structured Facts table for hard truths, provenance and category-aware decay on every record, and a nightly cross-agent dream brief. Local-first, MIT, $0 to run with Ollama. Current version 4.28.4.

Mnemo Cortex runs on Linux, macOS and Windows (natively, no WSL, since v4.4.1; macOS support is in beta). It needs Python 3.11+; Ollama is recommended for local reasoning and embeddings (default embedding model `nomic-embed-text`), and the setup wizard also takes OpenAI, Google, Anthropic or OpenRouter keys. Auth is fail-closed: the setup wizard and the zero-prompt installer bind the server to loopback (127.0.0.1), where a token is optional; it refuses to bind any other interface without an auth token unless you explicitly opt out. Data lives in `~/.agentb` (the setup wizard's choice and the server's default). The zero-prompt installer (`robot-install.sh`) keeps data in `~/.mnemo-cortex` and reasons on OpenRouter by default, so set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` first, or use the all-local reasoning block shown in `robot.install` for no key and no cloud. If a robot install stopped starting after v4.9.5, re-run the installer: memories are kept (copied from `~/.agentb`, originals left in place). Details: `install.install_paths` in robot.info.

What a record carries: a `source` (user / tool / inferred / brain / migrated) and a `category`. Topology facts age fast (warn at 30 days, stale at 90) and recall returns a structured `stale_warning`; doctrine, incident, identity and decision never decay. Smart Ingestion classifies every save, two-tier recall puts distilled notes ahead of raw session logs, and the Analyst distills each day's logs into notes. Recall blends similarity, recency, category importance and access frequency; since v4.21 a BM25 keyword lane finds exact identifiers the vectors miss.

Beyond recall:
- **Structured Facts** — (entity, attribute, value) triples with a confidence ladder (verified > high_probability > false); since v4.23 a slot can be locked to an authority tier (probe / declared / open), and a write that doesn't match becomes a proposal for the user to settle.
- **Trajectories** — step-by-step recipes of tasks that went well, recalled before similar tasks.
- **Dreaming** — a nightly pass that compacts each agent's memories and merges them into one brief every agent can read (`GET /dream/latest`).
- **Memory Ledger** (v4.20) — a tamper-evident chain over what the store was told; `verify` names any record that changed or went missing.
- **The Librarian** — one SQLite FTS5 index over the whole workspace so an agent can turn "the file about X" into a path. It replaced the older auto-compiled wiki; the existing wiki pages stay searchable but are no longer rebuilt.
- **Cortex Stick** — encrypted USB sync between two installs, no cloud.
- **Developer's Passport** (beta) — observed user behaviour is recorded as a candidate and becomes a user-context claim only after an explicit promotion step.
- **The Muse** — an idea-extracting sibling of the Analyst, shipped off by default.

## Docs

- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/INSTALL.md): The install guide in plain English: server setup plus wiring for each host. Start here to install.
- [README](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/README.md): Overview, features, the five-step install, troubleshooting.
- [CORTEX-OS.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/CORTEX-OS.md): The operating manual for an agent that just got Mnemo Cortex: how to use it well.
- [SESSION-GUIDE.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/SESSION-GUIDE.md): Workflow patterns, per-platform boot snippets, common mistakes.
- [THE-LANE-PROTOCOL.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/THE-LANE-PROTOCOL.md): The operating practice for running agents with persistent memory.
- [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/PRIVACY.md): Data handling, telemetry policy, outbound calls.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/SECURITY.md): Supported versions and how to report a vulnerability.
- [MONITORING.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/MONITORING.md): Health-check tooling, log layout, operational signals.
- [macOS install](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/docs/install-macos.md): The one macOS gotcha (which Python can load SQLite extensions), Homebrew, launchd.

## Integrations

- [Claude Code](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/claude-code): 60-second install for the Claude Code CLI.
- [Claude Desktop](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/claude-desktop): Drag-and-drop `.mcpb` bundle. Windows, macOS, Linux.
- [Codex CLI](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/codex): MCP setup for OpenAI's Codex CLI.
- [OpenClaw](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/mcp-bridge): OpenClaw uses the MCP bridge below (the old `integrations/openclaw-mcp/` path is deprecated and only points there).
- [MCP Bridge](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/mcp-bridge): The generic Node.js stdio bridge every MCP integration spawns. Versioned in its own `package.json`.
- [ChatGPT](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/docs/install-chatgpt.md): Not MCP: a Custom GPT calls two REST actions through a hardened, tenant-pinned gate, so the server never faces the internet. Read the OpenAI plan requirements first.
- [LM Studio](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/lmstudio): Native MCP, GUI configuration.
- [AnythingLLM](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/anythingllm): Desktop GUI, multi-workspace.
- [Agent Zero](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/agent-zero): Autonomous Docker agents, in-container MCP.
- [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/hermes): `hermes mcp add`, Hermes Agent v0.12.0+.
- [Ollama Desktop](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/tree/master/integrations/ollama-desktop): Terminal launcher with OpenClaw as the MCP host (Ollama's own chat window has no MCP).
- [Other local LLM hosts](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/docs/local-llm-hosts.md): Open WebUI, llama.cpp, LobeChat, Jan and others over stdio MCP.

## Agent Manifests

- [robot.info](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/robot.info): Structured product manifest (JSON). Identity, capabilities, REST endpoints and MCP tools, install pointer, compatibility, common questions and answers. Read this first to answer a user's question about Mnemo Cortex.
- [robot.install](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/robot.install): The settings file the non-interactive installer reads. Fill it in and run `./robot-install.sh` for a zero-prompt install that reports JSON on stdout. Not the install guide: that is INSTALL.md.
- [ROBOT-INFO-SPEC.md](https://github.com/GuyMannDude/mnemo-cortex/blob/master/ROBOT-INFO-SPEC.md): Specification for the robot.info convention (v0.2).
